description: Locks in the current roster-color property: removing a PLAYER (PLAYER_LEFT) frees their seat color for a new player, and a later re-add does NOT automatically reclaim the old color -- colorNumber now lives entirely on the ROLE_ASSIGNED event itself (the host's own explicit choice, validated for availability by assign_role), not derived at fold time. join_order (and so turn-order 'number') still survives a leave/re-add unchanged. Server: _apply_roster_event + _finalize_roster (app.py), replayed by tests/test_roster_fold.py. Client: RosterReducer, replayed by RosterReducerTest#fixtureRoundTripMatchesServer, which folds these events via apply() and then calls syncFromRoster(expectedRoster) -- mirroring RunePartyPlugin's real live flow, since apply() alone never reconstructs 'number'/'colorNumber' from the event stream (see that test's own doc for why). Kept in sync by hand across the two separate repos -- there's no shared build between them (see check_event_parity.py's own doc for the same constraint on the event-type parity check).
